content:
Hi!

I’ve finished updating the Lean version for the metaprogramming book.
It was previously using v4.17.0-rc1, but it’s now been updated to the latest version.

https://github.com/leanprover-community/lean4-metaprogramming-book

There were very few places that required nontrivial changes during the update, but there was one significant exception.

The section on transparency in the metam chapter had become outdated due to changes in Lean itself, so it required a substantial revision. I investigated the changes and updated the section as best I could, but there may still be mistakes.
I would appreciate it if you could point out any errors.
